hints.title: Chunked Buffer Transfer Strategy
hints.text: The problem requires transferring characters in fixed-size chunks of four until reaching the target destination count or exhausting the underlying source.

hints.title: Loop Termination and Boundary Slicing
hints.text: Repeatedly invoke the read function into an intermediate staging array. Copy elements one by one into the target destination buffer until n items are copied or end-of-file is encountered.

hints.title: Step-by-Step Copy Blueprint
hints.text: Maintain copied_chars count and a temporary 4-character array. While copied_chars < n, call read4. Iterate through received characters up to read count, write to destination, and break when copied_chars equals n.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Executes at most ceil(N / 4) reads with fixed 4-character intermediate buffer.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Reading unbuffered streams directly into destination without bounds checks can overflow the buffer beyond n characters.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant extra auxiliary memory of 4 elements balances chunked API requests.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct EOF handling when read4 returns fewer than 4 characters.

solutions.approach: C++ Buffer Iteration with Early Exit
